mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a chilly 42 degrees out near Badger Ridge Middle School under a First Quarter moon.

The City of Verona has announced that the Zoning and Sign Ordinance has been updated to streamline development standards, and residents are encouraged to use the interactive map on the city website to verify their specific zoning district. Additionally, voters are reminded to check the My Vote Wisconsin website to confirm their current polling location, as two new locations were approved last year.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join a yoga session tomorrow at Insight Wellness or participate in trivia nights starting this coming Monday at various local venues.

The Verona Police Department reported an incident from this past Thursday, October 15, where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I after officers responded to reports of dangerous driving behavior while children were on board. No injuries were reported, and the investigation is ongoing.
If you are looking for a treat, today's flavor is Mint Cookie, and the restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM for your enjoyment.
